description: GraphQL lets a client ask for specific fields of data. A schema describes what can be asked for. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install graphql@16. Save one example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. These examples execute queries locally and do not need an HTTP server.
versionNote: Examples use GraphQL.js 16 and Node.js 20 or later.
whatYouWillLearn: Ask for one field with GraphQL
Keep query text and values apart with GraphQL
Reuse a field selection with GraphQL
learningObjectives: Ask for one field with GraphQL
Ask for a change with GraphQL
